mentions.name: Vital Stack
mentions.description: A supplement-drug interaction database focused on safety rather than efficacy, answering whether it is safe to take a supplement alongside existing medications. It catalogs 182 supplements and 1,312 interactions and includes an MCP server that lets AI assistants query the interaction database in real time.
mentions.problem: Supplement-drug interaction data typically lives in clinical pharmacology databases and isn't easily surfaced in a way consumers can use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building in the same space. vital-stack.com focuses specifically on interactions between supplements and drugs, rather than efficacy: the question "is it safe to take with what I'm already on" rather than "does this work". The interaction data typically lives in clinical pharmacology databases and isn't easily surfaced in a way consumers can use. We have 182 supplements and 1,312 interactions catalogued so far, with an MCP server that lets AI assistants query the interaction database in real time.
